errors.text_span: which demarcate six contiguous bins (5-10, 10-15, 15-20, 20-25, 25-30, and 30-35)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly interprets the bar chart as a histogram with contiguous bins. The x-axis labels (5, 10, 15, etc.) represent discrete categories for each bar, not the boundaries of bins.

errors.text_span: The first bar for the 5-10 interval reaches an approximate value of 0.38.
errors.evidence: This statement, and others that follow, incorrectly assigns data to an interval (e.g., '5-10 interval') instead of the discrete category shown on the x-axis ('5'). This error stems from the incorrect interpretation of the chart as a histogram.

errors.text_span: The tallest bar is located in the 10-15 interval at approximately 0.41, followed closely by the 15-20 interval bar at nearly the same height.
errors.evidence: This statement incorrectly identifies the order of the two tallest bars. The bar for category 15 (described as '15-20 interval') is visually the tallest, while the bar for category 10 (described as '10-15 interval') is the second tallest. The description reverses their ranking.
